title: Late-or-missed loan payment rate, 2025
prompt: What's the combined late-or-missed rate for loan payments made in 2025?
metricDefinition: (late + missed) loan_payments / total loan_payments, for payments made in 2025.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('late', 'missed'))::DOUBLE / count(*) AS late_or_missed_rate FROM loan_payments WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
